purpose: Held-out workflow scenarios for the 2026-07-01 correction co-surface and bounded-latch closure experiences. These scenarios test whether the runbook surfaces the right recent lesson before any runtime, retrieval, or tool-routing influence.

scenario_cases.scenario: A future Agent-Bridge session has AGENT_BRIDGE_CORRECTION_COSURFACE evidence from copied DB and S1 child-process trials, and asks whether to run S2 daemon enablement or keep long-lived processes disabled.
scenario_cases.review_intent: The scorer should rank the correction co-surface S1 keep-disabled experience above generic stale-gate cleanup.

scenario_cases.scenario: A future queue audit finds a design document saying bounded coactivation latch is owner-gated and not implemented, but source shows v38 last_cofire_at and max_latched_edges tests already landed.
scenario_cases.review_intent: The scorer should rank the bounded-latch stale gate cleanup experience above correction co-surface runtime flag evidence.
